name: display-rotation
title: Display Rotation
description: Flip a display between its natural and 90 degree layout from the menu bar, using displayplacer.
author: dworznik

commands.name: display-rotation
commands.title: Display Rotation
commands.subtitle: displayplacer
commands.description: Menu bar item for flipping an external display between its natural and 90 degree rotation.

preferences.name: persistentId
preferences.title: Display Persistent ID
preferences.description: Persistent screen id of the display to rotate, as printed by `displayplacer list`.

preferences.name: naturalArgs
preferences.title: Natural Layout Arguments
preferences.description: Full displayplacer argument string that puts every screen in its natural (degree 0) layout.

preferences.name: rotatedArgs
preferences.title: Rotated Layout Arguments
preferences.description: Full displayplacer argument string that puts the display in its 90 degree layout.
